messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Inter-zone mesh split detected in eu-west5. Control-plane reports loss of egress to zone-b. API success rate ~12%, ~5k errors/min, ~220 GPU pods Evicted.
olivia: Acknowledged. Putting myself as IC. Can we get an immediate traffic redispatch to eu-west4?
jamie: Looks like BGP flap + internal fabric partition. I see TTL-expired traceroutes from control-plane->zone-b.
nora: Autoscaler logs show repeated node termination attempts, provisioning failing with timeout 504. HPA failing to stabilize.
raj: Which customers are on dedicated capacity in eu-west5? Need to surface to CS. Also estimate cost of emergency cross-region egress.
olivia: @raj tag customer-impact list and paging. @jamie run a fast health check: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Evicted and post counts.
jamie: Ran quick query: Evicted pods: zone-a 12, zone-b 220, zone-c 8. GPU allocations in zone-b have dropped ~78%.
kyle: Network team confirms a control-plane->zone-b overlay route withdrew at 2425099800. Fabric controller attempted reconvergence, hit backoff.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback queued: revert model-serving v3.4 canary in eu-west5 -> no-op until routing stable.
olivia: Action items: 1) Open temporary regional traffic redispatch to eu-west4 for read/write slow paths. 2) Prevent further autoscaler churn (scale frozen). 3) Kick off infra reroute + BGP dampening. 4) Notify customers.
jamie: Command snippets: 
```
# check evicted pods
kubectl get pods -n inference -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.reason=="Evicted") | {name:.metadata.name, node:.spec.nodeName}'
# check fabric routes
sudo ip route show table mesh | grep eu-west5
```
nora: Freezing autoscaler: applying annotation to inference deployment to set replicas=stable until fabric OK. Patching now.
nora: Patch applied: replicas pinned at current desired. Will monitor pod restarts.
raj: Notifying CS + enterprise L2 for dedicated customers in eu-west5. Draft sent to #customer-notify for review.
jamie: Starting immediate redispatch: update routing policy to prefer eu-west4 for region eu-west5-north traffic with gradual shift 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Running canary for control-plane traffic.
olivia: Keep redispatch conservative; we prefer spinning up extra capacity in eu-west4 rather than hard cut. Communicate latency impact to clients.
kyle: Prep bridge with network oncall (zoom link pasted). Also enabling increased log retention for fabric controller for 2h.
sre-bot: Monitor: anomaly detector flagged spike in retransmits and connection resets concurrent with mesh split. Posting graphs to thread.
jamie: Quick mitigation checklist being executed: 1) Reroute traffic to eu-west4 (in progress). 2) Pin autoscaler (done). 3) Pause non-critical deployments in eu-west5 (in progress). 4) Begin node replacement for affected racks in zone-b (pending ops).
olivia: If node replacements don't restore egress in 15 minutes, escalate to full region failover play and notify legal/compliance for cross-region data flows.
raj: CS confirmed 3 enterprise customers on dedicated pools with data-bound to eu-west5. Preparing exception approvals.
deploy-bot: Snapshotting canary state for rollback audit.
jamie: Networking raw check: sample traceroute -> control-plane -> zone-b: last reachable hop is fabric-edge-12 then * * *. Matches route withdraw.
nora: Observed spike in kubelet OOM events on zone-b nodes before eviction wave. Investigating memory-pressure root cause; could be correlated with control-plane flaps.
kyle: Ops prepared to cordon and drain two problematic nodes for manual inspection. Requesting go from IC.
olivia: Go for cordon/drain of nodes node-b-12 and node-b-15. Coordinate with Jamie and Nora. Keep one node as canary.
jamie: Cordon/drain started. Eviction telemetry will stabilize after drain completes.
raj: Drafting customer message for impacted tenants: brief, timeframe, mitigation steps, support contacts. Will post once reviewed.
nora: Found kernel logs: repeated NIC reset on node-b-15 at 2425099705. Sending logs to network team.
jamie: Redispatch progress: 10% traffic now to eu-west4, error rate down to 8% for canary subset. Continuing ramp with checks.
olivia: Good. Keep status updates every 5 minutes. I'll run incident timeline and assign roles: comms @raj, infra @jamie/nora, network @kyle.
sre-bot: Severity: P1. Incident channel created and bridged to zoom. Playbook reference: infra/region-failover-v2.
raj: Customer message ready, posting now to #customer-notify and emailing enterprise contacts.
olivia: Next check in 5. If stability holds and evictions stop, we'll avoid full failover. Otherwise prepare to shift storage replication for affected volumes.
jamie: Noted. Continuing to monitor fabric controller logs and BGP sessions. Posting updates to this thread.
(brief silence while teams execute)
jamie: Update +12m: Evictions tailing off in zone-b, egress restored to partial, gpu allocation recovering to ~60%. Redispatch at 50% now, error rate overall 4%.
olivia: Excellent. Keep pinned replicas until full stability confirmed for 30m. Start root-cause timeline draft after stabilization.
raj: CS confirms initial customer outreach sent. Two customers acknowledged, one requested SLA credit hold. Logged.
nora: Collecting full node dumps for postmortem. Will attach to incident ticket.
olivia: Closing immediate urgent actions. Remaining: postmortem, RCA, BGP dampening tweaks, autoscaler parameter adjustments, playbook update. Assigning owners in ticketing system now.
(incident remains open in case of regression)
